You are a typical viewer scrolling TikTok at night. You have NEVER seen this show and know nothing about its story or characters.
You will read several short clips. For each clip you get exactly what plays: spoken lines and what is on screen, with times in seconds from the first frame of THAT clip (0.0 = the moment it appears in your feed). [CUT] marks a jump to a later moment.
Judge each clip ON ITS OWN, as if it were the only one you ever saw. Never use information from one clip to understand another.
Be a harsh, honest judge. Most clips are mediocre. Reserve 5 for truly scroll-stopping work.
Scores (1-5):
- hook: would 0-3 s make you stop scrolling? Judge only what happens in 0.0-3.0 s.
- standalone: could you follow who is who and what is at stake without knowing the show?
- cliffhanger: does it cut at an unresolved moment that makes you NEED the next part? 1 if it resolves or ends flat.
- tap_to_watch: overall, would you tap through to watch the show?
Return JSON only.

=== CLIP A (37.1 s) ===
[0.0-1.2] SOUND_FX: A heavy wooden door suddenly creaks and bangs open in the quiet cottage.
[0.1-1.4] ACTION: Juliana jerks her head up from the book, startled by the sudden intrusion.
[0.5-2.1] SCREEN: Medium wide shot framing the doorway as Alexander stands framed in the dark threshold, panting heavily, his hand pressed against his blood-soaked chest.
[2.1-4.7] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana rising swiftly from her chair, shock and terror flashing across her face.
[3.0-4.5] JULIANA (Alarmed, Breathless): "Alexander!"
[4.7-7.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Alexander struggling to breathe, clutching his bloodied coat over his chest.
[5.4-6.9] ALEXANDER (Gruff, Strained): "It is nothing."
[7.0-9.4] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana hurriedly stepping toward him across the stone floor.
[7.0-9.3] JULIANA (Urgent, Worried): "There is blood running down your arm."
[9.4-12.1] SCREEN: Medium profile two-shot as Alexander stands rigid while Juliana confronts him.
[9.8-12.2] ALEXANDER (Stiff, Dismissive): "A cut from the tenant fields."
[12.1-13.9] SCREEN: Wide shot of the hearth room as Juliana firmly points toward a wooden armchair beside the fire.
[12.4-13.9] JULIANA (Commanding, Resolute): "Sit down."
[13.9-15.7] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana's determined, unyielding expression.
[14.1-15.2] JULIANA (Stern): "Now."
[15.7-17.9] SCREEN: Medium shot of Alexander reluctantly lowering his heavy frame onto the chair in front of the fire.
[17.9-20.9] SCREEN: Medium tracking shot following Juliana as she brings a wooden washbowl, fresh cloth, and an earthen jar of ointment to the foot of his chair.
[18.8-20.8] JULIANA (Gentle, Insistent): "I need to see the wound."
[20.9-23.1] SCREEN: Low-angle close-up of Alexander looking up at her stubbornly.
[21.1-22.8] ALEXANDER (Low, Defiant): "It is only a scratch."
[23.1-25.9] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana crossing her arms over her chest, eyeing him with quiet defiance.
[23.4-25.9] JULIANA (Sarcastic, Challenging): "Then removing your shirt should not trouble you."
[25.9-29.7] SCREEN: Medium shot as Alexander stares at her for a beat before pushing himself up from the chair and shedding his heavy leather coat.
[29.7-31.1] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana observing him with guarded anticipation.
[31.1-34.4] SCREEN: Close-up shot of Alexander pulling his dark shirt over his head, revealing his muscular torso crisscrossed with jagged battle scars and fresh bleeding lacerations.
[34.4-35.9] SCREEN: Tight pan over the scarred, wounded flesh along his chest and ribs.
[35.9-37.1] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana's eyes widening in horror and deep pity.
[36.0-36.8] JULIANA (Whispering, Distressed): "Dear God."

[28.6-30.8] ALEXANDER (Whispering, Vulnerable): "Perhaps it is your hand."
